summary: Promotion flow now requires compare artifact candidate/metric alignment before promotion, and scheduler regenerates strategy_compare before running promotion.
Established sprint artifacts, patched compare/promote/health, enabled quant-mvp autopilot continuous improvement, and moved project tracking into git-visible docs files.
simulateBacktest now separates signal close_t from execution open_t_plus_1, aligns buy/sell restrictions to execution day, and records signal/execution dates in trade artifacts.
runPortfolioBacktest now computes the current day target set while execution reads from a carried pendingTargetSet, establishing the first validated bridge toward day-t signal / day-t+1 execution.
